name: PolicyGuardBench
description: Autonomous web agents are increasingly deployed for long-horizon tasks, yet their ability to adhere to real-world policies remains critically underexplored compared to standard safety objectives. To address this gap, we introduce PolicyGuardBench, a benchmark of 60k policy-trajectory pairs designed to evaluate compliance through both full-trajectory and novel prefix-based violation detection tasks. Using this dataset, we train PolicyGuard, a lightweight guardrail model that achieves strong detection accuracy while maintaining high inference efficiency.
